description: context-vault: auto-inject local knowledge into session context

hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "foreach ($n in 'PLUGIN_ROOT','CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT') { $v = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($n); if ($v) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($n, $v.Replace('\\?\UNC\','\\').Replace('\\?\','')) } }; $r = $env:PLUGIN_ROOT; if (-not $r) { $r = $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if ($r) { $w = Join-Path $r 'hooks/run-hook.cmd'; if (Test-Path $w) { & $w 'skills/vault-loader/scripts/session_start_load.py'; exit 0 } }; [Console]::Error.WriteLine('[context-vault] hook wrapper not found (tried PLUGIN_ROOT, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT)'); exit 0"

powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "foreach ($n in 'PLUGIN_ROOT','CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT') { $v = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($n); if ($v) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($n, $v.Replace('\\?\UNC\','\\').Replace('\\?\','')) } }; $r = $env:PLUGIN_ROOT; if (-not $r) { $r = $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if ($r) { $w = Join-Path $r 'hooks/run-hook.cmd'; if (Test-Path $w) { & $w 'skills/vault-loader/scripts/prompt_submit_load.py'; exit 0 } }; [Console]::Error.WriteLine('[context-vault] hook wrapper not found (tried PLUGIN_ROOT, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT)'); exit 0"
